content.description: BlockchainX Tech, established in India and the United States, unites a 100+ strong team delivering secure blockchain software solutions for startups and enterprises for over six years. It specializes in token and NFT development and in building custom blockchain projects tailored to client needs, focusing on the cryptocurrency and enterprise aspects of blockchain, with emphasis on supply chain and fintech applications worldwide.
